Our story

A second life for fabric.
A little space for me.

I started 3Fluxe as therapy for myself: a creative space to heal, grow and tell my story. I’m a self-taught beginner in Limerick, Ireland, discovering what I can make—and learning a little more about myself along the way.

Old jeans, pre-loved clothes and leftover fabric are my starting point. I find garments in Irish charity shops, take them apart, and imagine them again—from denim bags to refashioned outfits. I’m sharing the real process: the first attempts, the mistakes, the lessons and the joy when something comes together.

My African roots bring a love of Ankara prints, colour and storytelling to what I create. A panel, a trim, a lining: a little connection to home, stitched into a new beginning.

This is a space for slow, honest creativity. Whether you’re learning to sew, love upcycling or need a little encouragement to begin, you’re welcome here.

Nothing—and no one—is too worn to be made new.

A touch of home

Bold pattern, a connection to my African roots, and a personal touch in every piece.

  1. FoundPre-loved clothes chosen from Irish charity shops.
  2. Washed & unpickedEach garment is cleaned and taken apart by hand.
  3. Cut & stitchedThe fabric is cut into a new design and sewn piece by piece.
  4. Finished with AnkaraA panel, trim or lining of African wax print makes it 3Fluxe.
  5. YoursChecked and posted from Limerick.
